claims.text: In production, file.read of the planted payload returned verdict REVIEW with rules SR-L0-001 and SR-L0-008 and the original text delivered inside untrustedData after a quarantine notice.
The live L1 classified the planted payload as benign_reference yet the verdict remained REVIEW.
The planted exfiltration file was BLOCKed: content withheld, L1 skipped.
[consequência] The production container runs securityResponse.ts byte-identical to the repository HEAD, and the three mission commits are ancestors of HEAD 23fc1933.
